evidence.limitations: Actual source original ZIP SHA256 5376aac7f12f981299bf0b4a964a4f6c453f501eb1b8ce29df1ce59f90b7b836. No independent site protocol detail in this occurrence-core export.
Derivative of E01 source; verified missing eventID/locationID/effort columns on THIS export, not upstream holdings.

evidence.claim_scope: Original eventDate 5-category label cross-tab and interval-duration counts
evidence.limitations: Source/time/status coupling is descriptive and strongly confounded; not model cheating or causality.

evidence.claim_scope: Archived author model CSV 23 columns, pinned 2024 Serov original
evidence.limitations: Derived from same original GBIF occurrence root; original author model CSV lacks eventDate and identity IDs.

evidence.claim_scope: Official GBIF temporal interpretation explicitly allows eventDate ISO date-time interval syntax
evidence.limitations: Independent standard definition, not external confirmation of 2024 source's full site history.

evidence.claim_scope: Actual R112 source exact SHA execution reveals invalid calendar date false-positive; corrected R118 and R122 source-byte validated
evidence.limitations: One software pipeline does not supply independent ecological data. R122 handles day/ISO timestamp but rejects interval as eligible distinct-visit timestamp.

evidence.claim_scope: Prior 4.97 NAAMP original 337 visits/130 sites with biological survey event identifiers
evidence.limitations: Independent different US frog species/year; not a matched verification of Finnish 2024 Anemone.

claims_and_director_decisions.claim: 2024 archive bytes from preserved 4.95 original have exact historical SHA and 29,543 occurrences
claims_and_director_decisions.rationale: Original nested ZIP was verified, physically read and forced full count.

claims_and_director_decisions.claim: Historical 2024 occurrence-core ZIP contains eventID, locationID, samplingProtocol and samplingEffort columns
claims_and_director_decisions.rationale: Actual 50-column header lacks all four; this says nothing about alternate upstream event-core dataset.

claims_and_director_decisions.claim: This exact historical ZIP alone proves identifiable same-site independent repeat visits
claims_and_director_decisions.rationale: Missing event/site/effort IDs make R112 strict candidates zero; actual repeats may exist but cannot be certified here.

claims_and_director_decisions.claim: Historical eventDate encoding is associated with original recorded ABSENT/PRESENT labels
claims_and_director_decisions.rationale: 11,165/11,166 recorded ABSENT use intervals, versus 3,012/18,377 PRESENT; association, not a causal explanation.

claims_and_director_decisions.claim: Retrospective date-format status rule correctly reproduces 26,530 of 29,543 labels in original same sample
claims_and_director_decisions.rationale: 89.8013% in-sample label accuracy, no heldout, selected after inspecting labels, not ecological prevalence prediction.

claims_and_director_decisions.claim: Serov original published predictive CSV used raw eventDate date-format as a model covariate
claims_and_director_decisions.rationale: Pinned original 23-column CSV omits eventDate entirely; source-level encoding alone does not demonstrate author model feature leakage.

claims_and_director_decisions.claim: Darwin Core slash-delimited interval is an error or itself proves at least two survey visits
claims_and_director_decisions.rationale: Published ISO eventDate permits intervals, and endpoints encode window bounds not independent visits.

claims_and_director_decisions.claim: Corrected R118/R122 source-byte code handles valid dates and ISO timestamps, and fails closed for invalid calendar and interval revisit candidates
claims_and_director_decisions.rationale: Local execution and SHA equality confirmed; still no real individual visit ID in historical source.

claims_and_director_decisions.claim: Halt 4.95 same-site occupancy estimation from this original occurrence-only file without external event-core/site protocol
claims_and_director_decisions.rationale: No event/site/effort fields, so user cannot justify repeated-visit identifiability from archival ZIP alone.

claims_and_director_decisions.claim: Seek source-producer event histories or explicitly independent matched revisits instead of reusing coordinate/year duplicates as visits
claims_and_director_decisions.rationale: Provenance and sample unit required to test conditional detection; other 4.97 taxon cannot substitute.

claims_and_director_decisions.claim: Protect Faraday/Maxwell independent Q3/Q4/Q5/Q7 track while grounding Q2 in real GBIF raw evidence
claims_and_director_decisions.rationale: Research governance rather than a new physical-science claim.

claims_and_director_decisions.claim: Promote MQR 5.5 or call the eventDate-status diagnostic an independent novel law
claims_and_director_decisions.rationale: Strong standard-compliant reporting and known data selection rivals, no incremental independent physical prediction.
